messages:
maya (Account Exec): Heads-up — Pegasus wants a POC next week. Requirements: sustained 500 QPS, 2k burst headroom, p99 tail <150ms for text generation, multi-region failover (US/EU), KMS/HSM + SOC2 evidence, and a rough cost estimate for a 24h soak. They want the actual run Friday if possible. Who can own scheduling and run?

jamie (Sales SE): I can own the run. Need sample prompt mix + streaming vs non-streaming requirement from the customer. Plan: smoke test -> ramp (0->500 QPS over 30m) -> 24h soak -> burst tests. Propose model variants rwl-3b (cheap) and rwl-13b-quant (cost/latency trade).

jamie (Sales SE): Quick load runner example (we'll use vegeta for HTTP endpoint):
```
echo '{"input":"Summarize: <long doc>"}' | vegeta attack -rate=500 -duration=600s -header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | vegeta report
```
This gets us throughput baseline; for soak we'll run sustained for 24h with periodic 2k QPS 60s bursts.

lee (Infra Ops): We can provision a Dedicated pool in us-west & eu-west. Starting config to hit 500 sustained + burst: 4x A100-equivalent in each region with autoscale headroom. If we do private HSM integration there is an extra ~24-48h setup and limited regions.

lee (Infra Ops): Ballpark cost for 24h soak (infra only): ~$1,400 per region (so ~$2.8k multi-region) + token CPU/GPU time for runs. With model variant mix (~70% 3B, 30% 13B-quant) I'd estimate total run cost ~ $3.5k - $4.5k. I'll do a detailed line-item after finalizing instance sizes.

anna (Product Eng): For p99 tail control: use quantized 13B for better throughput, enable async batching (target batch_size=6-8) and KV-prefix caching. Recommend setting max_tokens low for benchmark (e.g., 128) to make token cost predictable. Also note streaming adds overhead to p99 — prefer non-streaming for these latency targets.

security-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood.security/pegasus-sq. Top asks to prepare: SOC2 report, KMS type (Cloud KMS / HSM), data residency controls, access control matrix. Please @maya upload signed NDA and completed SQ.

maya (Account Exec): I'll send NDA and sample prompts by EOD Thu. Customer confirmed non-streaming; they care about SSL + bring-your-own-key (BYOK) with HSM. Can you finalize infra sizing and a firm cost estimate by tomorrow?

lee (Infra Ops): Will do. I need the exact prompt mix and expected average response token size (approx). If average output is ~80 tokens, the GPU utilization changes — share sample. I'll post a cost breakdown (instance hrs, storage, network, ops engineering) before EOD.

jamie (Sales SE): Tentative run scheduled Fri 09:00 PT. I'll coordinate load generator infra (we'll use k8s runners in us-west + eu-west to avoid cross-region network noise) and post a runbook here. @maya please confirm customer will provide sample prompts by EOD Thu.

maya (Account Exec): Confirmed — I'll loop legal for KMS/HSM appendix and push prompts. Thanks team :thumbsup:
internal_note: POC sales-support thread: planning mixed-workload throughput + security asks. Contains a short vegeta command for load run.
